content.value_statement: Writers need fast drafts that match the audience, channel, and goal. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to create structured content with hooks, value, and clear calls to action.
actual_capabilities: Drafts blog post outlines with headlines, hooks, sections, takeaways, and next steps.
Creates Twitter or X threads with numbered posts, context, key points, and a call to action.
Writes LinkedIn posts using personal stories, actionable points, hashtags, and engagement questions.
Structures email newsletters with subject lines, openings, value sections, and closing actions.
Applies headline formulas and content checklists to improve clarity, flow, and scannability.
Adapts tone and structure for audience expertise, pain points, and desired action.
limitations: It does not verify statistics, case studies, testimonials, or market claims without user-provided sources.
It does not publish content or connect to social media, email, or CMS platforms.
It needs audience, goal, brand voice, and channel details for the best results.
It provides drafting guidance and may need human review for legal, regulated, or sensitive claims.

use_cases.title: Plan a Blog Article
use_cases.description: Turn a topic into a clear article structure with a strong hook, sections, examples, takeaways, and next steps.

use_cases.title: Draft Social Posts
use_cases.description: Create platform-ready LinkedIn posts or X threads that match the channel format and invite useful engagement.

use_cases.title: Write Newsletter Copy
use_cases.description: Shape newsletter ideas into subject lines, openings, value sections, and calls to action for a defined audience.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Post
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a single social post.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a LinkedIn post about [topic] for [audience]. Use a clear hook, three useful points, and one engagement question.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Blog Outline
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a blog outline for [topic]. Include a headline, opening hook, problem section, solution section, examples, key takeaways, and next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt Content by Channel
prompt_templates.prompt: Repurpose this idea for a blog intro, LinkedIn post, X thread, and newsletter opening. Keep the audience [audience] and goal [goal].

prompt_templates.title: Create a Campaign Set
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for multi-touch content planning.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a one-week content plan for [offer]. Include daily hooks, target audience, channel, content angle, CTA, and success metric.

output_examples.input: Write a LinkedIn post about remote productivity for startup teams.
output_examples.output: A polished LinkedIn post opens with a personal productivity misconception, gives five practical remote work habits, and ends with an engagement question.

output_examples.input: Create a blog outline about reducing customer onboarding friction.
output: Headline focused on faster onboarding and fewer drop-offs.
Opening hook about where new users lose momentum.
Sections covering diagnosis, friction removal, examples, takeaways, and next steps.

output_examples.input: Draft a newsletter for a new analytics feature launch.
output_examples.output: A newsletter draft includes a curiosity-driven subject line, short customer problem setup, feature benefits, three learning points, and a clear product CTA.

best_practices: Provide the target audience, channel, desired action, and brand voice before asking for content.
Ask for sources or proof points when the content includes statistics, claims, or customer examples.
Review the draft for factual accuracy, brand fit, compliance needs, and platform limits.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for broad content without naming the audience, channel, goal, or offer.
Do not publish AI-generated claims, testimonials, or statistics without independent verification.
Do not reuse the same hook and CTA across every platform without adapting the format.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates drafts and structures for blogs, social posts, email newsletters, product descriptions, headlines, and marketing copy.

faq.question: Which tools does it support?
faq.answer: It is marked for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code in the generated report.

faq.question: Does it publish content automatically?
faq.answer: No. It only helps draft and improve content inside the AI conversation.

faq.question: Can it write for specific platforms?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for blog posts, X threads, LinkedIn posts, and email newsletters.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the audience, topic, channel, brand voice, goal, offer, and any proof points that must appear.

faq.question: Does it check facts?
faq.answer: No. It can organize claims, but users should verify facts, statistics, and compliance-sensitive statements.
